facts.value: In the Business English Foundation course, students learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. A variety of exercises are designed to promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current issues and to provide the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic topics. The reading and writing component of the course will be assessed in a 90-minute written exam during the last week of the semester. A graded certificate is issued for passing the exam.
